## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive/Quality tilt. AMD (ABOVE TREND), UNH (ABOVE TREND) and XOM (ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Major divergence across large-cap Tech and Financial names (MSFT, GOOGL, META, INTC) and mixed sentiment (INTC bullish but price down) are key risks to monitor.
